holidays.name: Foundation Day
holidays.description:
Absalom, Milani

Foundation Day is a civil holiday celebrated on the New Year (1 Abadius) in Absalom to commemorate the city's founding by the god Aroden in 1 AR.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.description:
Inner Sea Region

The first day of the Absalom Reckoning year is welcomed with rituals for luck and good fortune after the ghosts of the previous year's dead are believed to pass on during the Night of the Pale.

holidays.name: Pjallarane Day
holidays.description:
Irrisen

Pjallarane Day is an ancient holiday in Irrisen celebrated on 1 Abadius (New Year's Day). Every 100 years, Baba Yaga returns to Golarion to remove her daughter from the throne of Irrisen, and put another daughter on the throne instead. In 3713 AR the third Queen of Irrisen, Pjallarane, and her children chose to resist. Baba Yaga ruthlessly crushed the rebellion in a single day, which is now celebrated as a holiday. The festival includes feasting and the burning of effigies of tar and straw. This is a reminder of the fate of Pjallarane's followers, who were burned alive as a warning to all those who would oppose Baba Yaga.

holidays.name: Vault Day
holidays.description:
Abadar

Vault Day is a holiday held on 6 Abadius in honor of Abadar, Master of the First Vault.

holidays.name: People's Council Winter Session
holidays.description:
Andoran

Andoran's People's Council begins its winter session on 15 Abadius.

holidays.name: Ruby Prince's Birthday
holidays.description:
Osirion

The Ruby Prince's Birthday is a national holiday in Osirion in honor of the birthday of Khemet III, the Ruby Prince. It is celebrated annually on the 20 Abadius.

holidays.name: Merrymead
holidays.description:
Druma, Cayden Cailean

A holiday occurring on 2 Calistril, Merrymead was dateed in Druma and is supposed to be a time to share of the last of the previous year's mead with the rest of the community.

In current times, most people just use it as an excuse to drink excessively. The poor travel from bar to bar drinking whatever alcohol they can afford, while the wealthy will set aside specific vintages for this day. A known consequence of this day are 'mead riots' that happen when there are more celebrants than there is alcohol to serve them. This leads to a violent, destructive group of people in a crowded bar. If this is a common occurrence for particular cities, they may reinforce their guard force for the inevitably eventful night.

holidays.name: Founders' Day
holidays.description:
Vidrian

Vidrians observe Founders' Day on 7 Calistril, commemorating the truce among Mwangi peoples that led to the founding of the trade settlement that became Anthusis.

holidays.name: King Eodred II's Birthday
holidays.description:
Korvosa

King Eodred II's Birthday was a local holiday in the Varisian city-state of Korvosa and was celebrated on 16 Calistril. It commemorated the birthday of its former ruler, King Eodred Arabasti II, who decreed that on the day, scantily clad women would dance and serve free wine to celebrants.

holidays.name: Loyalty Day
holidays.description:
Cheliax, Asmodeus

Loyalty Day is a holiday in the nation of Cheliax commemorating the date on Calistril 19, 4640 AR when House Thrune signed the Treaty of Egorian, declaring it the victor in the Chelish Civil War and ruler of the empire. Because of House Thrune's well-known ties to the infernal, this holiday is also observed by the Church of Asmodeus who consider it a feast day. The church along with local governments provide a free meal to all citizens to remind them of the benefits House Thrune provides them with.

holidays.name: Fateless Day
holidays.description:
Mahathallah

Followers of Mahathallah mark each leap day as Fateless Day, when the River of Souls temporarily stops and souls can escape Pharasma's judgment. They perform many sacrificial and suicidal rituals on Fateless Day.

holidays.name: Leap Day
holidays.description:
Inner Sea Region

The intercalary 29th day of Calistril is added every four years to keep the Absalom Reckoning calendar accurate.

holidays.name: Day of Bones
holidays.description:
Pharasma

Priests and worshipers of the Lady of Graves parade the bodies of the recently dead on this holiday, holding free burials afterwards.

holidays.name: Sable Company Founding Day
holidays.description:
Korvosa

Sable Company Founding Day is a holiday marking the founding of the Sable Company of the Varisian city-state of Korvosa. Celebrated on 6 Pharast, the day is marked by somber military parades that generally preclude the consumption of alcohol, a staple on most other holidays.

holidays.name: Night of Tears
holidays.description:
Solku

The Night of Tears held annually on 7 Pharast in the Katapeshi town of Solku. It is a solemn vigil commemorating those lost in the Battle of Red Hail in 4701 AR.

holidays.name: Kaliashahrim
holidays.description:
Qadira

Kaliashahrim is a national holiday celebrated on Pharast 13 in Qadira that celebrates the Padishah Emperor of distant Katheer, and Qadira's loyalty to him.

holidays.name: Conquest Day
holidays.description:
Nex

Every year, on the 26th of Pharast, Elder Architect Oblosk — oldest member of Nex's Council of Three and Nine — ascends to the highest balconies of the Bandeshar in Quantium. In a voice made thunderous by the platform's magic, the wizened pech councilman spends the hours from dusk to just past noon enumerating the atrocities committed by the necromancers of Geb upon the people of Nex, culminating with the disappearance of the archwizard Nex himself. At the conclusion of this record of national wounds, the country's eleven other council members join Oblosk in renewing their yearly vow to neither forget nor forgive the Gebbites' atrocities and to again swear in their lost ruler's name to endlessly wage war against their ancient enemies.

On this day, known as Conquest Day, all the people of Nex are expected to share in their leaders' oaths, to celebrate the shared patriotism of their wondrous nation, and to remember the sacrifices of heroes past. This also makes it a day for many Nexian wizards to reveal deadly new spells, gigantic constructs, and audacious arcane masterworks—which many creators promise to be the doom of their foes. Even throughout the rest of the Inner Sea region, many crusaders, rebels, and zealots observe Conquest Day as a day to renew blood oaths, launch long-planned battles, and finally take revenge. It is a day for words of honor, a day for battle cries, and a day where glory most favors the bold.

holidays.name: Ghorusan
holidays.description:
Nex

Ghorusan is Oenopion's great culinary festival, held on 31 Pharast in honor of the druid Ghorus. The city becomes a vast potluck featuring new foods, drinks, plant costumes, music, and the traditional glowing liquor called bathsilk.

holidays.name: Currentseve
holidays.description:
Gozreh

On this religious holiday, all who travel on the water make offerings to Gozreh in the hopes of safe passage for the coming year.

holidays.name: Taxfest
holidays.description:
Abadar

No one enjoys paying taxes but the collection of fair taxes is considered an integral part of the maintenance of society, and is therefore holy to the god Abadar. Every year on the 15th of Gozran, priests of the church of Abadar spend the day walking city streets, doing what they can to make the bitter pill of annual taxes a bit easier to swallow.

The Business of the Day

From dawn to dusk, clerics of Abadar attend the tax collectors of sizeable communities as the tax wagons roll from door to door. The church officials monitor these activities to make sure that the process is conducted respectfully and justly, and that citizens know that the process is monitored. More than just aiding in the yearly errand, the faithful personally thank every citizen for contributing to the improvement of their city, extol the public works funded by their contributions, and foretell the grandeur of civic projects to come. The disenfranchised and destitute they attempt to comfort as best they can, quoting from their god's dogma on work and worthiness, but this is not a day for discounts or deferrals. The citizens are able to voice their concerns and ideas as to where the monies levied should best be applied. Citizens are free to speak their mind on any issue here without fear of repercussion.

The Celebrations of the Day

At dusk, the Abadarans host several celebrations in parks, plazas, and other communal areas about the city, organizing donations and contributions from local vendors to feed and entertain all-comers. Having already preached to most of the city over the course of the day, the clerics perform only a brief opening ceremony, dedicating the feast to Abadar, the city, and its great people. These celebrations are often quite distinct from neighbourhood to neighbourhood and are almost always divided along economic boundaries.

The festivities involving the wealthiest citizens usually happen on the steps of city hall or other grand civic buildings and feature the best music and food, but often little more than polite card and guessing games. These galas usually wrap up by midnight.

For the common folk, the parks and marketplaces take on a carnival atmosphere, with simple but good food, local ales, performances by talented citizens, and games of chance going on well into the night. A prevailing superstition through these festivals is that, during the celebration, it is lucky to kiss—or in some regions, pinch—a cleric of Abadar, leading to many a rosy-cheeked cleric.

Even the city's poor are given reason to celebrate, as the local temple of Abadar hosts a cheery but unabashedly religious gathering on its steps, feeding all comers, doling out a hearty ration of wine, singing hymns of the faith, and providing tokens for a second wine ration for any who return to attend a service within the month.

For a holiday that revolves around paying taxes, this Abadaran festival is not as reviled as one might expect.

holidays.name: Wrights of Augustana
holidays.description:
Andoran, Brigh

This local festival in the Andoran port city of Augustana is held to honor and celebrate the local shipbuilding industry as well as the navy. The mathematics and engineering required for the building of the ships is praised by Brigh's faithful.

holidays.name: Gala of Sails
holidays.description:
Absalom

One of two local festivals where kite-battlers compete.

holidays.name: Ascendance Night
holidays.description:
Norgorber

Day marking the apotheosis of the Reaper of Reputation.

holidays.name: Azvadeva Dejal
holidays.description:
Gruhastha

Celebration of the revelation of the Azvadeva Pujila, with gifts of books, celebrations of knowledge, blessing of animals, and a vegetarian feast.

holidays.name: Old-Mage Day
holidays.description: Holiday celebrating Old-Mage Jatembe, the father of Garundi magic.

holidays.name: Angel Day
holidays.description:
Magnimar, Varisia

Angel Day is a local Magnimarian holiday celebrated on 31 Desnus. The annual celebration marks the founding of the city, and its founders' flight from Korvosa. It also honors the presence and popular worship of the empyreal lords, which predates the city by centuries. During the festival, nearly all local businesses shut their doors and the citizens take part in countless feasts, masquerade balls dressed as angels, and the burning of devil effigies meant to symbolize infernally-influenced Korvosa.

holidays.name: Rushlight Tournament
holidays.description:
Tymon, River Kingdoms

Tymon's annual Rushlight Tournament is held on 1 Sarenith.

holidays.name: Liberty Day
holidays.description:
Andoran, Milani

Holiday celebrating Andoran's independence. Milanites celebrate that very little violence occurred.

holidays.name: Burning Blades
holidays.description:
Sarenrae

The holy, month-long festival ends on this day, featuring dances with flaming blades.

holidays.name: Day of Remembrance of Mwangi Sovereignty
holidays.description:
Vidrian

On 19 Sarenith, Vidrians mark the final expulsion of Sargava's colonial government in 4717 AR with quiet reflection and silent toasts.

holidays.name: Talon Tag
holidays.description:
Andoran

The Eagle Knights perform aerial displays in Almas on this day.

holidays.name: Riverwind Festival
holidays.description:
Korvosa

An early summer holiday that honors a cooling shift in the winds, celebrated with much drinking.

holidays.name: Archerfeast
holidays.description:
Erastil

Archer's Day or Archerfeast is a holiday of the god Erastil held annually on the 3rd of Erastus. Despite the holiday's origins in the worship of Erastil, common country folk from the Lands of the Linnorm Kings to Taldor celebrate the height of summer with a day set aside for establishing new relationships, enjoying current camaraderie, and celebrating the gifts of the gods. Archery competitions are held frequently in which the men test their skill with the bow through progressively harder trials. The exact form of competition is different from place to place, and the winner is awarded a rack of elk horns and a quiver of blessed arrows. He is also given the title of "Protector", which he holds until the next year.

While the festival's traditions emphasize contests of marksmanship, most have expanded to exhibit talents of all types, from baking and storytelling to racing and mock combat. Aside from encouraging a fair-like atmosphere, many of the displays and competitions serve one of two secondary purposes: either as a way for merchants to show off their superior livestock and wares, or (more popularly) as a way for eligible men and women to show off to each other.

While the day's events at most Archerfeast fairs are filled with games, food, and crafts, the night brings dancing, drinking, pranks, and the crowning of the princes and princesses of spring and summer for the two single youths and two single adults who fared best in the day's events. The festivities continue late into the evening, but end promptly at midnight, so that in true Erastilian fashion the next day's responsibilities are not overly impeded. For those not of Erastil's flock, however, private parties, drinking, and trysting carry on long into the next morning.

holidays.name: Talmandor's Day
holidays.description:
Andoran

Andorens honor their celestial patron and national symbol, the avoral Talmandor, on 4 Erastus.

holidays.name: Founding Festival
holidays.description:
Korvosa

Founding Festival is a local Korvosan celebration marking the establishment of the city in 4407 AR. Held annually on 14 Erastus, the festival is a chance for the citizens to let off some steam, drink copiously, and watch magical light shows late into the night.

holidays.name: Kianidi Festival
holidays.description:
Garundi

The Kianidi Festival is a week long event held annually between 15 and 21 Erastus by Garundi people everywhere. The Garundi have a powerful belief in belonging to a specific location in this world, with clans or tribes sometimes traveling for years in search of their true home. In these travels each individual will collect small mementos of the places she or he has visited in order to remember them and maintain a spiritual connection. During the Kianidi, a tribe will gather and display these mementos to the group. The best ones are chosen and made part of the clan or tribal history, something which Garundi feel is a great honor.

holidays.name: People's Council Summer Session
holidays.description:
Andoran

Andoran's People's Council begins its summer session on 15 Erastus.

holidays.name: Burning Night
holidays.description:
Razmiran

Items or people who have transgressed against the god-king of Razmiran are burned on this day.

holidays.name: Inheritor's Ascendance
holidays.description:
Iomedae

Inheritor's Ascendance, originally called 'Herald's Day', honours the day that Iomedae was chosen by the god Aroden to become his herald (thus replacing Arazni), thus boosting her power beyond that of a fledgling goddess. This holiday was renamed after the demise of Aroden.

holidays.name: Crusader Memorial Day
holidays.description:
Mendev

Observed on 6 Arodus in remembrance of the crusaders who fought against the demons of the Worldwound.

holidays.name: Day of Silenced Whispers
holidays.description:
Ustalav

The Day of Silenced Whispers is an Ustalavic holiday celebrated every 9 Arodus marking the defeat of the Whispering Tyrant in 3827 AR by the coalition forces of the Shining Crusade and the liberation of the country after centuries of undead domination.

holidays.name: Founding Day
holidays.description:
Ilsurian, Varisia

Festival celebrating the founding by Ilsur of the town of Ilsurian in 4631 AR.

holidays.name: Armasse
holidays.description:
Aroden, Iomedae, Milani

The raucous, week-long festival known as Armasse is held each year beginning on 16 Arodus. The celebration — once dedicated to the god Aroden — is still important to the faithful of Iomedae, who use it to train commoners in combat, ordain apprentice clergy, pick squires for knights, and teach military history, hoping to prevent the mistakes of the past from being repeated. Among those not dedicated to the Inheritor the holiday has lost most of its religious significance since Aroden's death, tending now only toward wild partying, a fact that has precluded the diabolist authorities of Cheliax from prohibiting Armasse outright. Nevertheless, in places where the church of Asmodeus is openly allowed, it hosts special activities for its parishioners during the same week in an effort to counter the influence of the holiday. The city of Corentyn is especially known for its extravagant Armasse festivities.

holidays.name: Saint Alika's Birthday
holidays.description:
Korvosa

Quiet holiday honoring the birth of Saint Alika the Martyr.

holidays.name: Start of Classes
holidays.description:
Inner Sea Region

The customary start of the academic year is observed on 6 Rova.

holidays.name: Day of the Inheritor
holidays.description:
Iomedae

Followers of Iomedae observe the Day of the Inheritor on 19 Rova.

holidays.name: Feast of Szurpade
holidays.description:
Irrisen

This "celebration of plenty" festival mocks the traditional harvest festivals celebrated in the region before Baba Yaga and her eternal winter descended upon the land.

holidays.name: Day of Sundering
holidays.description:
Ydersius

Once many holidays were celebrated by the faith of Ydersius, but today only this date has much significance.

holidays.name: Ascendance Day
holidays.description:
Iomedae

Ascendance Day is an Iomedaean holiday, held on the 6th of Lamashan. The day marks the anniversary of the day Iomedae took the Test of the Starstone in the autumn of 3832 AR and ascended to godhood.

Celebration

The day is a joyous celebration for the faithful, with singing, pledging of friendships, and forgiving of old grudges.

To many, the Test of the Starstone represents the greatest of all challenges, yet for Iomedae it was one of three storied promotions in her rise from Aroden's herald to a goddess in her own right. On the 6th of Lamashan, the Inheritor's faithful observe the heroism of Iomedae's life before her moment of ascension and celebrate the anniversary of the apotheosis itself.

The celebration takes place in several stages. Early in the day, troupes of performers—as often passionate amateurs as professionals—stage morality plays featuring the Eleven Acts of Iomedae, the heroic near-miracles and sacrifices she made leading up to her trials in the Starstone Cathedral. Scripts vary by region, city, and even neighborhood, but despite differences in setting, performance medium, and word choice, the themes and morals are all the same.

As the day continues, the priests organize jousts and mock battles, allowing anyone to participate so long as she can demonstrate enough skill to not be a risk to herself or others. The winners of these contests then face tests of mental acuity such as solving riddles, deciphering philosophical quandaries, and answering questions of honor and justice. Those who prove themselves in both contests are awarded a white cloak—representing the Inheritor at peace—styled after Iomedae's own red garment to wear for the rest of the celebration. Feasting and singing follow the competitions, mirroring the jubilation that followed Iomedae's ascension. This is occasion for making pledges of friendship and forgiving enemies, and priests circulate about the crowd offering the Inheritor's blessing to those who do and providing a moment's counsel or mediation for those who need an extra nudge.

The celebration typically ends before midnight, and the following day the priests and previous day's champions gather up the blunted swords from the mock battles, sharpen them, and distribute them among the church's armory and those of like-minded organizations so that all may remain vigilant against evil and prepared to strike it down.

holidays.name: Night of the Gray Death
holidays.description:
Galt

Galt commemorates the fall of the Gray Gardeners and the end of their hidden masters' reign on 13 Lamashan.

holidays.name: Kraken Carnival
holidays.description:
Absalom

The second of two local festivals where kite-battlers compete.

holidays.name: Jestercap
holidays.description:
Andoran, Druma, Taldor

Jestercap occurs at the end of the month of Lamashan, traditionally on the 27th (although a few regions have taken to moving the exact day around slightly so it always falls on the last Starday of the month, allowing people who wish to celebrate in excess to have the following day of rest to recover).

History

While Jestercap has been embraced with excited open arms by the gnome communities of the Inner Sea region, its original genesis is said to have been in one of Taldor's coastal cities not long after King Aspex the Even-Tongued broke from the nation, significantly weakening Taldor's power and beginning that nation's long decline. The holiday was originally intended to distract the distraught Taldan populace with a night of revelry and comedic entertainment, but the antics of jesters were simply not enough.

Over the course of the first few years, Jestercap evolved from a holiday of observation to a holiday of participation. Today, the holiday is a time where anyone can pull pranks or jokes or japes on companions, on neighbors, and (most typically) on rivals, with the understanding that provided no lasting harm is done, any humiliations inflicted before midnight are to be taken in stride. Of course, come morning the day after, there are inevitably jokes that went too far, and grudges and feuds borne from Jestercap antics have a way of lingering for months to follow.

In Religion

Followers of Chaldira Zuzaristan, a halfling deity of mischief, treat Jestercap as a holy day and their pranks — often elaborate and extravagant in nature and plotted for months in advance — as displays of their faith.

holidays.name: Allbirth
holidays.description:
Lamashtu

Observed on 30 Lamashan, Allbirth began as an occult celebration of monsters and has also become a secretive masquerade centered on heritage, art, dance, and ritual combat.

holidays.name: Festival of the Witch
holidays.description:
Irrisen

Irrisen observes the Festival of the Witch on 30 Lamashan.

holidays.name: All King's Day
holidays.description:
Galt

Galt observes the anniversary of its formal declaration of independence on 5 Neth.

holidays.name: Independence Day
holidays.description:
Galt

Marks the beginning of the Red Revolution.

holidays.name: Abjurant Day
holidays.description:
Nethys

Abjurant Day occurs on 8 Neth and is known as a day of cooperation between neighbors to shore up mutual defenses and train allies in magic. Potential apprentices are often tested on the day.

holidays.name: Great Fire Remembrance
holidays.description:
Korvosa

Great Fire Remembrance is a holiday celebrated on each 13 Neth in the Varisian city of Korvosa. It commemorates the Great Fire of 4429 AR, which devastated the then still fledgling Chelish colony of Fort Korvosa. On this somber day, most of the city shuts down and people generally remain at home. It has become tradition not to light any fires (not even cooking fires) on Great Fire Remembrance.

holidays.name: Even-Tongued Day
holidays.description:
Cheliax, Asmodeus, Milani

Observed on 14 of Neth, Even-Tongued Day was once a day of joy and celebration in Cheliax, but has become instead one of mourning.

Originally, the date marked the conquest of Aspex the Even-Tongued, who brought the nations of Galt, Andoran and Isger under Chelish control. Since the death of Aroden and the loss of these nations, the holiday instead marks the loss of territory and glory once held by Cheliax. Oaths are sometimes made, typically to Asmodeus, and rarely of a pleasant nature (such as the reclaiming of the lost empire and vengeance against treacherous former allies).

Citizens wear black on this day, public speaking is forbidden, and old feuds and vendettas are rekindled.

holidays.name: Evoking Day
holidays.description:
Nethys

A holy day to followers of Nethys, Evoking Day is full of vibrant explosions, skillful wielding of spells, and much dancing. Evoking Day is observed on the 18th of Neth, and while this holiday is mostly celebrated in Garund, temples dedicated to Nethys host celebrations throughout the Inner Sea region. Traditional celebrations of Evoking Day have changed over the thousands of years since its first incarnation, but to this day every occurrence of Evoking Day still features a grand meal shared by celebrants during the afternoon and a wondrous exhibition of brilliant and explosive magic once the sun sets. These days, such colorful magical displays are augmented with fireworks of a dozen different colors and patterns.

In temples of Nethys dedicated to revering evocation magic, priests and prominent arcanists participate in spell duels where each contestant stands on a raised platform and takes turns trying to incapacitate her opponent. The magic wielded in theses duels favors the flashy over the dangerous, but clerics of Nethys are on hand to treat any injuries. These duels gather large crowds eager to lend their applause to their favorite contestant.

It is also during this festival when wizards who worship Nethys open their spellbooks to others who share their craft. Wizards normally guard their spellbooks with their lives and covet the eldritch information therein, but on Evoking Day these wizards meet with one another prior to the afternoon feast to share their spells just as they prepare to share a grand meal.

Though Evoking Day is primarily a day of grand magic, those with no spellcasting talent still flock to local temples of Nethys to partake in the shared feast and flashy evening displays of magic and fireworks. Between the meal and into the night, celebrants wear black-and-white robes and perform joyous dances meant to give thanks to the wonders Nethys brought to humankind. These dances are grand affairs involving dozens of dancers all spinning and clapping to the accompanying music as their black-and-white robes fan out around them with each spin. As night descends and the fireworks and magical displays begin, the dancing rises to a climax erupting in shouts and calls to Nethys with each thunderous boom.

holidays.name: Seven Veils
holidays.description:
Sivanah

The holiday known as Seven Veils, which takes place on the 23rd of Neth in most realms of the Inner Sea region, is a celebration of the region's diversity — a time when social boundaries break down even further in a day-long event filled with dancing, feasting, and courting. The evening traditionally closes out with the Seven Veil masquerade, a ball wherein the participants wear disguises that hide their race or gender (often using minor magical trinkets and spells) or disguise these features as entirely new characteristics. At the end of the ball, the participants remove their disguises to their partners, often with unpredictable and sometimes delightfully awkward results. Traditionalists and conservative minds often find the Seven Veils masquerades to be scandalous or off-putting, yet they remain particularly popular in most of the larger cities of the land.

Historians note that the original "Dance of the Seven Veils" has a much different genesis than one promoting diversity — the mysterious cult of Sivanah, goddess of illusions, mystery, and reflections, is generally cited as the source of this festival, and indeed, worshippers of the goddess (herself known as the Seventh Veil) count the 23rd of Neth as one of their most sacred of days. What rituals the church of Sivanah performs on this date, however, are unknown to outsiders, for the cult enjoys its secrets. This secrecy has, unsurprisingly, given rise to all manner of sinister rumour, yet when Seven Veils rolls around each year, its eager participants are quick to set aside rumour in preference for the night's fun and games.

holidays.name: Baptism of Ice
holidays.description:
Irrisen

In the Irriseni Baptism of Ice, an annual fertility festival held from the 24th to the 30th of Neth, locals parade all children born during the year through the town in fine clothes. In most towns, the festival ends with a symbolic sacrifice of a child to the cold. However, in Whitethrone and Irrisen's provincial capitals, a peasant child is killed through exposure.

holidays.name: Transmutatum
holidays.description:
Nethys

Transmutatum is one of the three major holidays of the church of Nethys, on 28th of Neth. It is a day of reflection and self-improvement. Many followers of Nethys begin research and crafting projects on this day.

holidays.name: The Shadowchaining
holidays.description:
Zon-Kuthon, Nidal

Commemorating the Midnight Lord's gift of shadow animals.

holidays.name: Pseudodragon Festival
holidays.description:
Korvosa

Korvosa's Pseudodragon Festival, a holiday celebrated annually on 7 Kuthona, marks the winter migration of wild pseudodragons from the Mindspin Mountains to Conqueror's Bay, which inspires the creatures already in the city—even those domesticated—to play with their wild kin in the skies over the city. Locals mark the day with a joyous inebriation.

holidays.name: Ascension Day
holidays.description:
Cayden Cailean

Much like the god to whom it is dedicated, the Caydenite holiday of Ascension Day is generally celebrated in a very informal style. Occurring annually on 11 Kuthona, it commemorates the day Cayden Cailean passed the Test of the Starstone and ascended to godhood in 2765 AR. In all likelihood, the 11th of Kuthona is not the exact date on which it actually happened, but since the god was dead drunk when it happened, it will probably be never known.

holidays.name: Grand Abnegation
holidays.description:
Geb

The Grand Abnegation is observed annually on 12 Kuthona in memory of the night Geb renounced life and returned as a ghost. Blood Lords hold extravagant feasts, Gebbites bow toward the Cinerarium, and some living citizens arrange to become undead at the hour of the Ghost King's death.

holidays.name: Winterbloom
holidays.description:
Naderi

Holiday celebrating Naderi's ascension. Celebrations are typically understated but include readings of The Lay of Arden and Lysena.

holidays.name: Final Day
holidays.description:
Groetus

Cultists of Groetus perform an hour's silence at dusk on the last day of the year and seek guidance from their god about the End Time.

holidays.name: Night of the Pale
holidays.description:
Not all of Golarion's holidays and festivals are times of rejoicing and delight. Holidays worshiped by dark and sinister cults and religions tend to be hidden affairs, their rituals and ceremonies involving cruelties and vile practices that send shivers of fear through gentler society. Scholars suspect that the Night of the Pale—a holiday that traditionally takes place on the last day of the year, the 31st of Kuthona—has links to several sinister religions, but today no one church has specific association with the event. Nonetheless, the Night of the Pale is an event that many look forward to all year, whether in fear or excitement.

On the Night of the Pale, it is said that the ghosts of those who died during the previous year manifest upon the world and come to visit the homes they lived in during life. Although some might think that the chance of seeing even the shade of a dearly departed one might be a blessing, the Night of the Pale is not a time for tearful reunions, for these ghosts, tradition says, do not return out of love for those they left behind but out of darker compulsions. Lingering jealousy, unfinished arguments, or the simmering need for revenge are said to be what compels the dead to return to torment the living on the Night of the Pale.

The evening of this night in many communities is celebrated by a morbid feast, the food prepared with themes revolving around graveyards, the dead, and other spooky traditions. This feast, on one level, helps the celebrants to make light of their fears while sharing good company with similarly nervous neighbors, but at another level is believed to placate vengeful spirits as toasts are raised to the memories of the recently departed. These feasts include retellings of favorite memories of the departed, in hopes of reminding the approaching ghosts of brighter and kinder memories than those that compel them to return. The feast always ends at least an hour before midnight in order to give participants time to return home, decorate doors and windows with salt and other trinkets taken from the feasting table (salted bread baked into crook-like shapes are a favorite, as these can be hung from doorknobs and eaves) to ward off evil spirits, and hide in their bedrooms until dawn. Brave youths and adventurers often deliberately stay out after midnight, either to dare the ghosts to challenge them or simply for the thrill of bucking tradition. Every Night of the Pale, it seems, there are disappearances among those who stay out after midnight, although whether these vanishings are the result of dissatisfied locals taking the opportunity to run away from home, murderers or wild animals or other mundane dangers, or the vengeful spirits carrying off their victims depends upon the circumstances.

The morning after a Night of the Pale is also the first day of the new year—a time that many celebrate more as a relief for surviving the night before than in anticipation of what the new year might bring, although regional preferences for how this day is celebrated vary enough that no single tradition holds over the other. Save, of course, the lingering fears of what dread spirits might come knocking upon warded doors one year away...

events.description: The archmage Nex captures the Isle of Jalmeray.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Nex captures the Isle of Jalmeray (Nex)
Teikoku expansion stops at the Forest of Spirits
events.description: The Teikoku Shogunate's territorial expansion reaches the Forest of Spirits and advances no farther.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Yixing founds Chu Ye and annexes Xa Hoi
events.description: The empire of Yixing establishes Chu Ye and absorbs Xa Hoi.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Xhai Xen Xiao founds Goka
events.description: The visionary Xhai Xen Xiao establishes the city of Goka.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The dwarves abandon Dongun Hold
events.description: Tired of exploitation during the war between Geb and Nex, Dongun Hold's dwarves collapse their tunnels and retreat into the Darklands.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Kalistrade's tomb is discovered
events.description: Followers discover the tomb of Kalistrade, strengthening the emerging faith and institutions built around his prophecies.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The Pirate Siege of Absalom (Absalom)
The Pirate Siege threatens Absalom
events.description: Pirates and other villains blockade Absalom after Aroden's departure, forcing the city to recruit foreign mercenaries with grants of land and titles.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: The Spirit Road is fully mapped
events.description: Explorers complete a trade route from Teikoku to Hongal known as the Spirit Road.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Taldor’s Second Army of Exploration pushes north beyond Lake Encarthan (Taldor)
Taldor's Second Army reaches Lake Encarthan
events.description: Taldor's Second Army of Exploration advances north beyond Lake Encarthan.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Yixing annexes Goka
events.description: The empire of Yixing finally absorbs the growing city of Goka.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Khiben-Sald arrives at Quantium
events.description: The Maharajah Khiben-Sald reaches Quantium with the Hundred and One Ships.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Khiben-Sald brings Vudran culture to Jalmeray
events.description: The legendary maharaja Khiben-Sald begins a decade on Jalmeray that brings Vudran culture to the Inner Sea.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Khiben-Sald brings Vuldran culture to the Inner Sea (Nex)
Nex vanishes (Nex)
Nex vanishes during the siege of Quantium
events.description: Nex disappears from his capital during a Gebbite attack that kills thousands.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Thousand-Year War unofficially ends
events.description: Nex devastates Geb, Geb animates a vast army of the dead, and Nex vanishes during the resulting poison attack on Quantium, causing the war to peter out.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: The Council of Three and Nine is established
events.description: Nex establishes the Council of Three and Nine as the ruling government responsible for holding the country together after his disappearance.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: The Council creates the divine appointment failsafe
events.description: The Council of Three and Nine establishes a compact allowing Pharasma and Nethys to replace unfit members of the Three from among the Nine.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: The three arteries of Nex are completed
events.description: The principal roads linking Quantium, Ecanus, and Oenopion are completed as the core of the Circulation of Nex.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Bachuan is founded
events.description: The city-state that later becomes Bachuan is established.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Geb attempts escape Golarion (Geb)
Geb returns as a ghost
events.description: Geb attempts ritual suicide but returns as a ghost bound to his realm.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Geb commits ritual suicide and returns as a ghost
events.description: On 12 Kuthona, Geb takes his own life in a ritual suicide and soon returns as a ghost. Gebbite tradition commemorates the event as the Grand Abnegation.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Pixies settle in Omesta
events.description: A host of pixies enters Omesta and is welcomed by the city's gnome inhabitants.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Tar-Baphon is born (Ustalav)
Tar-Baphon rises to prominence
events.description: The mortal necromancer Tar-Baphon first rises to prominence and draws the attention of Aroden.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Tar-Baphon attacks Kestrillon
events.description: Tar-Baphon attacks the settlement of Kestrillon during his rise as the Whispering Tyrant.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Tar-Baphon conquers the city of Kestrillon
Tar-Baphon claims the whole the Isle of Terror for himself
Aroden defeats Tar-Baphon on the Isle of Terror
events.description: Aroden mortally wounds the wizard-king Tar-Baphon on the Isle of Terror in Lake Encarthan.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Aroden mortally wounds wizard-king Tar-Baphon (Avistan)
Foreverie is officially created
events.description: An unknown elf artist officially creates Foreverie, a magical charcoal-and-colored-pencil sketch whose changing dancers and locations appear to mirror the elusive Endless Dance troupe.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Travel Guide

events.name: Hungry Bones launches her great raids
events.description: Gnoll matriarch Hungry Bones unites several clans and leads them in raids against Mzali, Elokolobha, and Kibwe.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Shattered Bones brings gnoll mercenaries to Kibwe
events.description: Hungry Bones's successor retires from raiding and takes warriors north to Kibwe, where she brokers their service as mercenaries.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Aroden names Arazni his herald
events.description: Aroden encounters Arazni after her transformation into an angel and appoints her as his divine herald.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.name: Artokus Kirran creates the sun orchid elixir
events.description: Artokus Kirran formulates the first sun orchid elixir.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Artokus Kirran formulates the sun orchid elixir (Thuvia)
Thuvia founded (Thuvia)
Thuvia's city-states unite
events.description: The city-states of Thuvia band together as a single nation.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Siege of Prophets (Absalom)
The Siege of Prophets attacks Absalom
events.description: Mysterious Prophet Kings besiege Absalom, prompting construction of Starwatch Keep.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Aganhei is executed
events.description: Aganhei is executed for establishing an overland trade route between Tian Xia and Avistan.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The Resplendent Phoenix makes its first voyage
events.description: The Resplendent Phoenix completes its inaugural voyage; Yixing begins regular western trade two years later.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The Absalom Reconciliation synchronizes major calendars
events.description: Absalom's guilds invite representatives from across Golarion to align the days and months of the Casmaron Unified Calendar, Imperial Calendar, Jatembe's Light, and Long Night Calendars with Absalom Reckoning.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Travel Guide

events.name: Taldor conquers the northern Inner Sea coast
events.description: Taldor's Third Army of Exploration conquers the northern shore of the Inner Sea and founds Corentyn.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Taldor conquers the northern shore of the Inner Sea (Taldor)
Mirnbay is founded in Iobaria
events.description: The settlement of Mirnbay is founded during Iobaria's long period of human expansion and settlement.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Dragon's Demand / Iobaria chronology reproduction

events.name: Qadira takes control of Osirion (Osirion)
Qadiran operatives overthrow Pharaoh Menedes XXVI
events.description: Qadiran agents depose Osirion's pharaoh and establish a succession of foreign rulers.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Dwarven Empire of Tar Taargadth collapses (Five Kings Mountains)
The empire of Tar Taargadth collapses
events.description: Orc assaults conquer several Sky Citadels and shatter the dwarven empire of Tar Taargadth.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Qadiran assassins kill General Coren
events.description: Qadiran agents assassinate the Taldan commander General Coren as conflict between the two powers intensifies.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Taldor and Qadira sign the Urian Peace
events.description: Taldor and Qadira sign the Urian Peace accords, temporarily ending their war.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The five dwarven kingdoms are established
events.description: Dwarven successor states begin forming from the ruins of Tar Taargadth, creating the five kingdoms that give the region its modern name.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The First Five Kings War begins
events.description: Civil war engulfs the Five Kings Mountains and neighboring human settlements.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The First Five Kings War erupts (Five Kings Mountains)
The Fifth Drumish Rebellion fails
events.description: The fifth rebellion against foreign control is defeated, and followers of Kalistrade organize into the institution known as the Promise.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The Lion Blades are formally founded
events.description: Taldor formally establishes the Lion Blades as an imperial intelligence organization.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Foundation of Vyre (Cheliax)
Vyre is founded
events.description: Settlers from Corentyn found Vyre in search of freedom from Taldor's strictures.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Taldor claims the future lands of Andoran
events.description: Taldor's Fourth Army of Exploration maps and claims the region that later becomes Andoran.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Taldor claims the lands that will one day become Andoran (Taldor)
Andoran is founded
Andoran is founded as a Taldan province
events.description: General Khastalus clears much of the Arthfell Forest and establishes Augustana, founding Andoran as a province of Taldor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Pu Duo establishes the Silk Network
events.description: Pu Duo creates the Silk Network while investigating the death of their mentor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Norgober passes the Test of the Starstone
Norgorber passes the Test of the Starstone
events.description: Norgorber follows Aroden's path through the Test of the Starstone and ascends to divinity.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Sigek attempts to shatter the cycle of reincarnation
events.description: Sigek and his followers perform a blasphemous ritual intended to force Nindoru's trapped soul into a new incarnation outside the cycle of life and death. The first accounts of nindoru fiends appear later that year.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Ulfen raiders descend on western Avistan
events.description: Ulfen longships raid the western coast of Avistan and the lands later known as Cheliax.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Ulfen raids along west coast of Avistan
Taldor expands into the River Kingdoms
events.description: Taldor's Fifth Army of Exploration advances through the River Kingdoms to the edge of Iobaria.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Taldor's Fifth Army launches with Worldbreaker
events.description: Taldor sends its Fifth Army of Exploration abroad with the Armageddon Engine known as Worldbreaker.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Vudrani rajahs wrest control of Jalmeray
Taldor loses the Worldbreaker to the Gorilla King
The Gorilla King captures the Worldbreaker
events.description: Taldor's Sixth Army of Exploration loses the magical siege engine Worldbreaker during a disastrous campaign in the Mwangi Expanse.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Taldor establishes Isger
events.description: Taldor's Seventh Army of Exploration defeats the Isgeri tribe and creates the protectorate of Isger.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Taldor formes the protectorate of Isger (Taldor)
Taldor's Seventh Army makes peace with Drumish Kellids
events.description: The Seventh Army of Exploration negotiates peace with Kellid tribes in Druma rather than conquering them.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The Sixth Drumish Rebellion founds the Meritocracy of Jelheg
events.description: A sixth uprising ends foreign domination and establishes the Meritocracy of Jelheg in Druma.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Jelheg is recaptured
events.description: Foreign forces retake Jelheg and end the short-lived Drumish meritocracy.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Druma's Mercenary League is founded
events.description: Druma establishes the Mercenary League, creating a professional military institution that will endure for millennia.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Irori's teachings reach mainland Tian Xia
events.description: The teachings of Irori spread to mainland Tian Xia.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Irori's teachings reach Tian Xia (Tian Xia)
Osibu strengthens its magical defenses
events.description: After Aspis Consortium agents stumble across Osibu while searching for life-extending alchemical compounds, the city reinforces its magical protections.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Cult of Sarenrae flourishes in Osirion (Osirion)
Osirion banishes Sarenrae's faithful
events.description: Osirion's Qadiran satrap exiles the growing Cult of the Dawnflower to the western deserts.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Osirion regains independence
events.description: The resurgent Cult of the Dawnflower overthrows Osirion's satrap and establishes an independent Keleshite dynasty.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Cult of the Dawnflower vanquishes the satrap of Osirion (Osirion)
The Arclords of Nex seize Jalmeray
events.description: After losing a Nexian power struggle, the Arclords of Nex take control of Jalmeray.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Pu Duo uncovers Aolin's deception
events.description: Pu Duo discovers evidence of Aolin's conspiracy and the false history surrounding Yixing.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The Promise calls in dwarven debts
events.description: The Prophets of Kalistrade use accumulated financial leverage to force the warring dwarven kingdoms toward negotiation.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The Kerse Accord ends the Five Kings War
events.description: Mediators from Druma establish the Kerse Accord, ending centuries of dwarven civil war.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Kerse Accord is established in Druma (Five Kings Mountains)
The Burning Glove Riots erupt in Druma
events.description: Violent unrest remembered as the Burning Glove Riots shakes Druma after the Kerse Accord.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Varisian settle Ustalav (Ustalav)
Varisians settle the future lands of Ustalav
events.description: Varisian migrants settle north of Lake Encarthan in the region later called Ustalav.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Jelhegi dissidents seize power in Druma
events.description: Dissidents associated with old Jelheg seize political control in Druma.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Orcs invade the Five Kings Mountains
events.description: Orc armies invade the Five Kings Mountains and threaten the dwarven realms.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Druma grants the Mercenary League a perpetual contract
events.description: Druma secures the Mercenary League's continuing service through a perpetual national contract.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The demon Treerazer begins his perversion of the forests of Kyonin
Treerazer begins corrupting Kyonin
events.description: The demon Treerazer begins his long perversion of Kyonin's forests.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Oath Wars begin
events.description: The clergies of Nethys, Norgorber, and Sarenrae begin fighting for supremacy in northwestern Garund.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Treerazer kills Hephloma
events.description: The demon lord Treerazer slays Hephloma, guardian of the Fierani Forest; Gendowyn's counterattack claims the Spiteful Scimitar but drives her wounded forces into Fangwood.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.name: Taggoret falls and the Era of the Five Kings ends
events.description: After seventeen years of war, the dwarven kingdom of Taggoret becomes the last of the Five Kingdoms to fall to the invading orcs, ending the Era of the Five Kings.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Highhelm / Five Kings chronology reproduction

events.name: Azir enacts the Laws of Man
events.description: Azir exiles its clergy, burns the temples, and formally adopts the Laws of Man.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The city of Azir enacts the Laws of Man (Rahadoum)
The Red Mantis settles Mediogalti Island
events.description: Fleeing the Oath Wars, the Red Mantis leaves Rahadoum and establishes a base on Mediogalti Island.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: The Red Mantis settles Mediogalti Island (Mediogalti Island)
The Oath Wars come to an end (Rahadoum)
The Oath Wars end
events.description: The spread of the Laws of Man ends the Oath Wars, and the Red Mantis relocates to Mediogalti Island.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Caldaru arrive at Boali
events.description: Caldaru settlers arrive at the city of Boali and begin nearly two decades of peaceful alliance and intermarriage with its people.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: The Caldaru destroy Boali
events.description: After years of alliance, the Caldaru raze Boali and retain control of Senghor, developing it into a major trading port.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Ustalav is founded
events.description: Varisian communities north of Lake Encarthan unite as the nation of Ustalav.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Ustalav is estabilished (Ustalav)
The elves return en masse to Golarion via the Sovyrian Stone (Kyonin)
The elves return through the Sovyrian Stone
events.description: Elves return to Golarion en masse through the Sovyrian Stone in Kyonin.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Treerazer's forces overtake Shevaroth
events.description: Treerazer's demonic forces capture the elven settlement of Shevaroth and expand their hold on southern Kyonin.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The Aspis Consortium establishes itself in Bloodcove
events.description: The Aspis Consortium gains a permanent foothold in the pirate port of Bloodcove.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Aolin is overthrown and erased from history
events.description: Aolin is incapacitated during a chadao ceremony, sealed away, and deliberately removed from historical records.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: First chadao tea ceremony (Tian Xia)
The first chadao tea ceremony is performed
events.description: Yixing courtiers perform the first chadao tea ceremony for their emperor in Tian Xia.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Choking Death Plague spreads west from Iobaria (Iobaria/Avistan)
The Choking Death devastates northeastern Avistan
events.description: The Choking Death spreads west from Iobaria and devastates human populations across northeastern Avistan.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Cayden Cailean passes the Test of the Starstone
events.description: Cayden Cailean drunkenly survives the Test of the Starstone and ascends to divinity.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Cayden Cailean survives the Test of the Starstone
The Murmur Dome appears in Prada Hanam
events.description: The mysterious Murmur Dome appears overnight and transforms the fishing village of Prada Hanam into a growing city.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Vudrani rajahs reclaim Jalmeray
events.description: Vudrani rajahs wrest control of Jalmeray from the decadent Arclords of Nex.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Goka is granted independent status
events.description: Empress Yin visits the growing City of Wonders at Goka and, impressed by its free spirit and skyline, grants it independent status outside Imperial Lung Wa's normal hierarchy.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Dragon Empires Gazetteer

events.name: Xhai Xen Xiao dies in Goka
events.description: Goka's visionary builder Xhai Xen Xiao dies after falling from the newly completed first spire of the Seven Dragon Bridge; rumors of assassination persist without proof.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Dragon Empires Gazetteer

events.name: The Conjured Siege attacks Absalom
events.description: The Arclords of Nex launch the Conjured Siege but are eventually repelled by Absalom's defenders.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: A violent earthquake rocks Qadira and Taldor, killing tens of thousands in both nations
An earthquake devastates Qadira and Taldor
events.description: A violent earthquake kills tens of thousands across Qadira and Taldor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Absalom enters the Age of Expansion
events.description: After mainland earthquakes weaken foreign influence, Absalom's citizens reclaim political control and begin an era of renewed construction, intervention abroad, and expansionist ambition.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Absalom, City of Lost Omens chronology reproduction

events.name: Aelthian attempts to banish Treerazer
events.description: The elven hero Aelthian leads an attempt to banish Treerazer and disappears during the failed assault.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Kyonin contains Treerazer in the Tanglebriar
events.description: Elven defenders halt Treerazer's expansion and confine his forces to the corrupted Tanglebriar.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Daralathyxl arrives at the Five Kings Mountains
Daralathyxl arrives in the Five Kings Mountains
events.description: The great red dragon Daralathyxl, called the Sixth King, arrives in the Five Kings Mountains.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Cheliax is founded
Cheliax is founded
events.description: Cheliax is established as Taldor's western frontier.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Calistrians vanish while trying to retake Shevaroth
events.description: Silisifex leads Calistrian warriors in an attempt to reclaim Shevaroth, but the entire force disappears.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The Yixing empire collapses
events.description: The human empire that succeeded Aolin's hidden dragon regime finally collapses.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Hwanggot is founded
events.description: The nation of Hwanggot is established.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The empire of Shu begins
events.description: Jiao Deng Shu is crowned and establishes the empire of Shu.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Assassins murder Grand Prince Jalrune (Taldor)
Grand Prince Jalrune is assassinated
events.description: Assassins murder Grand Prince Jalrune of Taldor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Khadon begins the dwarven reconquest
events.description: The dwarven leader Khadon begins a campaign to reclaim lands lost during the fall of the Five Kingdoms.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Tar-Baphon returns as the Whispering Tyrant
events.description: The lich Tar-Baphon unifies Belkzen's orc hordes and begins terrorizing central Avistan.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Tar-Baphon returns to life as the Whispering Tyrant (Ustalav/Avistan)
Tang Mai regains independence
events.description: Tang Mai breaks away from the empire of Shu and restores its independence.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The Six create A Love That Loss Can Bear
events.description: Six students at Kith bardic college create A Love That Loss Can Bear, an influential work combining Chelaxian opera with Kortosi dance.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Travel Guide

events.name: Katapesh becomes a nation
events.description: Katapesh is established as an independent nation.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Katapesh becomes a nation (Katapesh)
The Battle of Splitmist Pass founds Tar Khadurrm
events.description: A decisive dwarven victory at Splitmist Pass leads to the founding of the realm of Tar Khadurrm.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Emperor Jiao Deng Shu dies
events.description: Jiao Deng Shu dies at the age of 222.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Iranez joins the Council of Three and Nine
events.description: After establishing Her Most Keen Eye, Iranez of the Orb briefly joins the Council of Three and Nine.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Baba Yaga creates Irrisen
events.description: Baba Yaga conquers the eastern Lands of the Linnorm Kings and founds Irrisen.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The nation of Irrisen is born (Irrisen)
Jernashall creates the first safe magmafall
events.description: Dwarven engineers in Droskar's Crag construct the first successful and safe magmafall.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The first safe magmafall is created in Droskar's Crag (Andoran)
The dwarven capital moves to Jernashall
events.description: The capital of the Five Kings Mountains moves from Highhelm to Jernashall.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Battle of Eight Bridges (Tian Xia)
Setsuna Kuga wins the Battle of Eight Bridges
events.description: The Perfect Swordswoman defeats the Teikoku Shogunate, after which Minkai's forces raze the old capital.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Teikoku Shogunate is overthrown
events.description: The Teikoku Shogunate falls; the Minkai Empire is established three years later.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The Minkai Empire is established
events.description: The Minkai Empire is founded and Kasai becomes its capital.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Minkai Empire is established in Tian Xia.
Karamoss launches the Machine Mage Siege
events.description: The Numerian technomancer Karamoss assaults Absalom with metal automatons in an attempt to claim the Starstone.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Karamoss sieges Absalom (Absalom)
Dulin Tro's crime leads to Oenopion's Age of Commerce
events.description: Dulin Tro fleshwarps the child Ankquit Daal in Haagenti's image and escapes justice, prompting Iranez to impose reforms restricting fleshwarping experimentation.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: The Dragon Plague begins in Taldor
events.description: Magically controlled dragons begin a twelve-year rampage across Taldor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Jinin begins opening its borders
events.description: Jinin cautiously opens its borders and makes contact with explorers from Minkai.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Demons destroy Rastel and Xatremba
events.description: The long war between Rastel and Xatremba culminates when Rastel summons demons that scour Xatremba before turning on Rastel as well.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Tan Sui-Jing defeats Kugaptee
events.description: The heroic adventurer Tan Sui-Jing defeats the fiend Kugaptee but dies as the battle ends. Her body sprouts a sugi tree over the fiend's remains, trapping him beneath its roots.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: The Nightstalls open in Katapesh
events.description: The infamous Nightstalls open in the city of Katapesh during the Pactmasters' transformation of the city into a major mercantile power.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Companion: Dark Markets, A Guide to Katapesh

events.name: Taldor launches the Shining Crusade against the Whispering Tyrant (Taldor/Ustalav)
The Shining Crusade begins
events.description: Taldor launches the Shining Crusade against the Whispering Tyrant.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Shining Crusade reaches Lake Encarthan
events.description: The Shining Crusade establishes a beachhead on Lake Encarthan's northern shore in Ustalav.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Shining Crusade secures a beachhead on the northern shore of Lake Encarthan, in Ustalav
Iomedae takes command of the Knights of Ozem
events.description: The mortal Iomedae joins the Shining Crusade and rises to lead the Knights of Ozem against the Whispering Tyrant.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.name: The Knights of Ozem summon Arazni
events.description: The Knights of Ozem summon Arazni, warrior goddess and herald of Aroden, to aid the Shining Crusade.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Tar-Baphon humiliates and kills Arazni (Ustalav)
Tar-Baphon kills Arazni
events.description: The Whispering Tyrant humiliates and kills Arazni, herald of Aroden.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Tar-Baphon's forces build the great sepulchers
events.description: As the Shining Crusade advances, the Whispering Tyrant's armies construct underground storage complexes packed with preserved corpses.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.name: Iomedae creates Heart's Edge in her Sixth Act
events.description: During the Shining Crusade, Iomedae reforges the pieces of her shattered sword into the artifact Heart's Edge, a deed remembered as her Sixth Act.
events.sourceTitle: Published Iomedae chronology reproduced in multiple Pathfinder references

events.name: The Whispering Tyrant is imprisoned
events.description: The Shining Crusade imprisons Tar-Baphon within Gallowspire.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Whispering Tyrant is imprisoned in Gallowspire (Ustalav)
The Shining Crusade ends and Lastwall is founded
events.description: The Shining Crusade formally ends with Taldor founding Lastwall to guard the Whispering Tyrant's prison.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Foundation of the Taldor's holding of Lastwall
Iomedae completes her Tenth Act in Kantaria
events.description: Iomedae completes her Tenth Act after ruling Kantaria for a year and a day and defeating the faceless stalkers threatening the city.
events.sourceTitle: Published Iomedae chronology reproduced in multiple Pathfinder references

events.name: Iomedae passes the Test of the Starstone
events.description: The heroine of the Shining Crusade ascends to divinity and becomes Aroden's herald.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Iomedae successfully attempts the Test of the Starstone
Iomedae passes the Test of the Starstone and ascends to godhood
events.description: Iomedae enters the Starstone Cathedral, completes the Test of the Starstone, and rises to divinity. Her church commemorates the event annually as Ascendance Day on 6 Lamashan.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods; Pathfinder Campaign Setting chronology

events.name: Taldor signs the Treaty of the Wildwood
events.description: Taldor and the druids of the Verduran Forest end centuries of conflict and establish peaceful relations.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Taldor signs the Treaty of the Wildwood with the druids of the Verduran Forest (Taldor)
The War of Split Hearts begins
events.description: After High King Nkobe loses his only son and descends into violent paranoia, civil war erupts among the Mbe'ke dwarves.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: The War of Split Hearts ends
events.description: The Mbe'ke civil war ends with much of the old aristocracy dead, and the survivors establish a constitutional monarchy led by an Assembly-elected ruler.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: The Knights of Ozem launch the Second Crusade
events.description: A faction of the Knights of Ozem begins a new crusade against the undead nation of Geb in hopes of recapturing the glory of the Shining Crusade.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.name: The Sudachan coup fails in Tang Mai
events.description: The other four ruling families defeat the Sudachan family's attempt to monopolize the Cinnamon Throne and bar the family from leadership for fifteen generations.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Geb routs the Knights of Ozem's Second Crusade
events.description: The Second Crusade ends in disaster before reaching Geb's shores, and the ghost king captures the expedition's seven leaders.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.name: Geb abducts Arazni’s corpse and reanimates her as the lich Harlot Queen (Lastwall/Geb)
Geb raises Arazni as his Harlot Queen
events.description: Geb steals Arazni's remains, reanimates her as a lich, and forces her to rule beside him.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Merivesta Olinchi is assassinated
events.description: The Nexian playwright Merivesta Olinchi is murdered during the premiere of The Conception Exception.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Merivesta Olinchi is assassinated during the premiere of her masterpiece (Nex)
Gendowyn allies with Kraggodan
events.description: The fey queen Gendowyn enters a partnership with the dwarves of Kraggodan that endures for eighty years before Arlantia's betrayal.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.name: The Council of Mwanyisa takes power in Mzali
events.description: The Council of Mwanyisa overthrows Mzali's royal house and replaces the city's hereditary rulers.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: The Rending
The Rending devastates southern Avistan
events.description: Droskar's Crag erupts, devastating Darkmoon Vale and flooding portions of Almas.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Cult of Weeping Stars begins spreading through Nex
events.description: The apocalyptic Cult of Weeping Stars spreads through Nex from 3996 to 4000 AR before its prophecy fails.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: The empire of Shu dissolves
events.description: The empire of Shu breaks apart.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Hao Jin is born
events.description: Hao Jin is born in Goka; her later death and resurrection grant her the power of the phoenix.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Kazavon drives orcs from western Ustalav
events.description: Kazavon drives the orcs of Belkzen out of western Ustalav.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Kazavon drives the Belkzen orcs from western Ustalav (Ustalav)
Arlantia unleashes the Darkblight
events.description: The corrupted dryad Arlantia overthrows Gendowyn and releases the Darkblight in the Fangwood.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Qadira invades Taldor
events.description: The Qadiran army crosses Taldor's southern border.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Telda Hammereye creates Hearts of Stone
events.description: On the hundredth anniversary of the Rending, sculptor Telda Hammereye creates Hearts of Stone from silver and iron recovered from ruined Jernashall as a memorial to the clans destroyed in the disaster.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Travel Guide

events.name: Cheliax breaks from Taldor
The Even-Tongued Conquest begins
events.description: Chelish king Aspex breaks from Taldor and claims Andoran, Galt, Isger, and Devil's Perch, severely weakening Taldan influence.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Chelish explorers reach the Shackles
events.description: Explorers sailing from Cheliax first reach the islands of the Shackles.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Explorers from Cheliax first reach the Shackles (Garund/Cheliax)
Karas Novotnian enters Darkmoon Vale
events.description: Karas the Falcon begins pacifying Darkmoon Vale.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Karas “the Falcon” Novotnian enters Darkmoon Vale (Cheliax/Andoran)
Cheliax fails to conquer Absalom
events.description: Prince Haliad I's siege of Absalom fails, but Chelish gains in Garund secure the Arch of Aroden.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Cheliax takes control of the Arch of Aroden (Cheliax)
Cheliax establishes Sargava
events.description: Cheliax establishes the colony of Sargava on Garund's western coast.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Colony of Sargava founded by Cheliax (Cheliax/Sargava)
The Big Slip frees Eleder's enslaved halflings
events.description: Every remaining enslaved halfling in Eleder vanishes on 21 Desnus in an unexplained mass escape remembered as the Big Slip, prompting Sargava to ban the importation of enslaved halflings.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Imperial Lung Wa founded (Tian Xia)
Imperial Lung Wa is established
events.description: Imperial Lung Wa unites ten of Tian Xia's Sixteen Kingdoms of Shu.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Daralathyxl imposes tribute on Highhelm
events.description: Daralathyxl compels Highhelm to pay tribute and establishes the practice of receiving a dwarven emissary.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Belcorra Haruvex is born in Absalom
events.description: Belcorra Haruvex is born into a wealthy Absalom family with a powerful aberrant bloodline and a secret devotion to Nhimbaloth.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: The Yellow Death devastates Absalom (Absalom)
Yellowtongue Sickness ravages Avistan
events.description: A widespread outbreak of Yellowtongue Sickness ravages Avistan.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Haruvex family is expelled from Absalom
events.description: Absalom authorities discover the Haruvex family's secret sacrifices and drive them from the Isle of Kortos. The family flees to Andoran and falls into poverty.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Casandalee is defeated near the future Scar of the Spider
events.description: After fleeing Unity, Casandalee reaches the valley later known as the Scar of the Spider, creates a copy of herself with stolen technology, and is defeated by Unity's followers in the wreck of the Aurora.
events.sourceTitle: Iron Gods chronology reproduced from PathfinderWiki

events.name: Belcorra Haruvex begins constructing Gauntlight
events.description: Belcorra secretly returns to the Isle of Kortos and begins work on the magical lighthouse Gauntlight above the Empty Vault, opening passages toward the buried shrine and gathering aberrations for an attack on Absalom.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Belcorra completes Gauntlight and begins the Abomination Vaults
events.description: Belcorra completes the Gauntlight lighthouse and begins expanding the dungeons beneath it into the Abomination Vaults, compelling the surrounding subterranean peoples to serve her plans.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Belkzen retakes Urgir
events.description: Orc forces assault Lastwall and reclaim the former Sky Citadel of Urgir.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Orcs of Belkzen assaults Lastwall and retake Urgir (Hold of Belkzen/Lastwall)
The Roseguard defeats Belcorra and founds Otari
