events.description: The Roseguard kills Belcorra Haruvex at Gauntlight, losing Otari Ilvashti in the battle. The surviving members establish a port community named Otari in their fallen companion's honor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Diguo-Dashu invades Lung Wa
events.description: The armies of Diguo-Dashu invade Imperial Lung Wa.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: A Vudran earthquake kills thousands
events.description: An offshore earthquake causes devastating floods along Vudra's coast.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Eearthquake off the coast of Vudra
Musagani's ninsat invades Zi Ha
events.description: The immense nindoru Musagani leads a ninsat into Zi Ha and claims hundreds of victims before the giants of the City of Bone and Juniper defeat and banish him.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Lung Wa conquers Ootoya
events.description: Imperial Lung Wa destroys Ootoya's capital and council, annexes the tengu state, and renames the territory Kwanlai.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The last member of the Roseguard dies
events.description: Aesephna Menhemes, the last surviving member of the Roseguard, dies of natural causes, and the settlement of Otari begins to decline.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Otari is abandoned
events.description: Four years after the death of the last Roseguard member, the remaining residents depart and the original settlement of Otari is abandoned.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Zhong Shuqing records her dream of Desna
events.description: After dreaming that Desna guides her through a butterfly's life cycle, the Lung Wa scholar Zhong Shuqing writes an influential treatise on the souls of living things and the earth.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Aganhei's maps resurface
events.description: The suppressed maps of Aganhei's route between Tian Xia and Avistan return to circulation.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Genie Wars end (Katapesh)
Jhavhul is imprisoned after the Genie Wars
events.description: The Templars of the Five Winds imprison the efreeti warlord Jhavhul on Pale Mountain.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Stonescale kobolds colonize Otari
events.description: The Stonescale kobold tribe moves into the abandoned settlement of Otari.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Valash Raj is founded
events.description: The Valash Raj is founded in southern Tian Xia.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Lung Wa annexes Bachuan
events.description: After centuries of pressure, Imperial Lung Wa conquers Bachuan, renames it, and exploits its profitable trade routes.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Begining of the Everwar
Cheliax begins the Everwar
events.description: King Haliad III launches the Wars of Expansion, beginning a century-long struggle later known as the Everwar.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Gennaris III reclaims Zimar
events.description: Grand Prince Gennaris III retakes Zimar for Taldor during renewed war with Qadira.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The Pathfinder Society is founded
events.description: The Pathfinder Society is established in Absalom.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Pathfinder Society is founded in Absalom
The Pathfinder Society is founded
events.description: A group of adventurers meets in Absalom on 23 Desnus, conducts a pub crawl ending at the Wounded Wisp, and pledges to reunite annually to share discoveries, founding the Pathfinder Society.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The printing press is invented in Isarn
events.description: Printers in Isarn develop the printing press, transforming the spread of writing and political ideas in Galt and beyond.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The first Grand Convocation is held
events.description: The Pathfinder Society holds its first annual meeting during Desnus, names it the Grand Convocation, and adopts Explore, Report, Cooperate as its motto.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Pathfinder Society begins an organized recruitment drive
events.description: The Grand Convocation records 150 field agents and 18 venture-captains, and each member pledges to recruit two more Pathfinders before the next meeting.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Maklanni Menhemes begins the resettlement of Otari
events.description: After the Stonescale kobolds lure ships to their doom and are defeated by adventurers, Maklanni Menhemes leads the effort to resettle Otari as a lumber town.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Four founders form the Open Road Pact
events.description: Gregaro Voth, Selmius Foster, Kerinha Napsunar, and Durvin Gest form the Open Road Pact during an expedition into the Mwangi Expanse.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Kerinha Napsunar establishes a River Kingdoms lodge
events.description: Pathfinder founder Kerinha Napsunar establishes an early Society lodge in the River Kingdoms.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Grand Convocation moves to the Blakros Museum
events.description: Pathfinder Society membership reaches 500 active agents and 30 venture-captains, forcing the Grand Convocation to relocate to the Blakros Museum.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Durvin Gest explores Azlant
events.description: Pathfinder Durvin Gest explores significant portions of Azlant's ruins.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Pathfinder Society publishes its first Chronicle
events.description: Funded by Durvin Gest, the first volume of the Pathfinder Chronicles publishes accounts of Azlanti ruins and sparks unprecedented interest in Society membership.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Selmius Foster donates the future Grand Lodge
events.description: Selmius Foster gives a manor house and its grounds to the Pathfinder Society, which begins building permanent quarters and classrooms there.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Grand Lodge of Absalom is founded
events.description: The Pathfinder Society formally establishes the Grand Lodge, with rosters listing 4,000 active agents and 200 venture-captains.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The first Decemvirate is formed
events.description: Ten volunteer field agents establish the Pathfinder Society's first leadership council, known as the Decemvirate.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Construction of the Otari Mill and log flume is completed
events.description: Maklanni Menhemes completes the mill and ingenious log flume that establish Otari as a successful lumber town.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Abomination Vaults

events.name: Jistkan golem prostheses are rediscovered in Rahadoum
events.description: Rahadoumi treasure-hunters recover five ancient Jistkan prostheses, leading artificers in Manaket to decipher and revive the long-lost golem-based prosthetic tradition.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Guns & Gears

events.name: Taldor launches the Heaven's Step Offensive
events.description: Grand Prince Gennaris III carries the war into Qadira in the Heaven's Step Offensive. His victories open Qadiran territory to Taldan control before Keleshite intervention and Gennaris's assassination reverse the campaign.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #131: The Reaper's Right Hand / Taldor chronology reproduction

events.name: Geb petrifies Mastrien Slash's invading army, creating the Field of Maidens
events.description: Pirate Queen Mastrien Slash invades Geb with an army of warrior women. Geb turns the invading force to stone, creating the site later known as the Field of Maidens.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Pathfinder Selmius Foster is killed on Bhopan
events.description: Prominent Pathfinder Selmius Foster dies on the island of Bhopan while pursuing the Perennial Crown; his assistant Adolphus escapes with Princess Ganjay.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: The Pathfinder Society creates the Wall of Names
events.description: The Pathfinder Society creates the black-glass Wall of Names on the grounds of the Grand Lodge to memorialize Pathfinders killed in the course of duty.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-10: The Wounded Wisp

events.name: Montlarion Jeggare is born
events.description: Montlarion Jeggare, the Chelaxian explorer and patron whose expeditions and fortune later help establish Korvosa, is born.
events.sourceTitle: Guide to Korvosa

events.name: Durvin Gest casts the Lens of Galundari into the Nemesis Well near Osibu.
Durvin Gest seals away the Lens of Galundari
events.description: Durvin Gest casts the Lens of Galundari into the Nemesis Well near Osibu.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Adolphus and Ganjay found Nexus House
events.description: Adolphus and Princess Ganjay use treasure taken from Bhopan to establish Nexus House in Quantium, recognized as the Pathfinder Society's second official lodge.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Nidal falls under Chelish control
events.description: Cheliax conquers Nidal.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Kerinha Napsunar dies in Quantium
events.description: Pathfinder founder Kerinha Napsunar dies surrounded by Society friends and arranges for her adventures to be published ten years later.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Durvin Gest disappears in Garund
events.description: Famed Pathfinder Durvin Gest vanishes on an expedition to Garund, and the Decemvirate recalls and destroys every known copy of the fifth Pathfinder Chronicle.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Gregaro Voth disappears seeking the Open Road
events.description: Believing himself the last surviving member of the Open Road Pact, Gregaro Voth returns to the Mwangi Expanse to open its mysterious fey door and is recorded as dead.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Princess Ganjay dies and the Princess Assembly begins
events.description: Princess Ganjay dies in Quantium and Adolphus soon follows; Nexus House establishes a biennial ball in her honor called the Princess Assembly.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Forge War begins
events.description: Ordrik Talhirk murders his cousin and seizes the throne of the Five Kings, triggering the Forge War.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Beggar-Rajah Jharka begins his reign
events.description: Jharka becomes rajah of Jalmeray after freeing a marid and making three wishes.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.name: Construction begins on Skyreach
events.description: The Pathfinder Society begins building the five-towered Skyreach complex at the heart of the Grand Lodge.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Pathfinder Society completes Skyreach
events.description: After five years and an immense expenditure, the Pathfinder Society completes the Skyreach complex at its Grand Lodge.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Ordrik Talhirk wins the Forge War
events.description: The Forge War ends with Ordrik Talhirk's triumph and the establishment of his Droskarite theocracy.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Forge War ends with Ordrik’s triumph (Five Kings Mountains)
Hao Jin is declared missing
events.description: Goka's Bank of Abadar recognizes Hao Jin's disappearance and executes her will.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The Grand Lodge menagerie is founded
events.description: A donated fire beetle inspires the Pathfinder Society to establish a menagerie and begin constructing specialized habitats.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Lung Wa moves its capital to Changdo
events.description: Imperial Lung Wa relocates its capital to Changdo and begins building the Eternal Emperor statue.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The Society seals its original manor house
events.description: The Decemvirate boards, locks, and wards the aging original Pathfinder manor, inspiring a tradition in which initiates try to bypass its defenses.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The first Ruby Phoenix Tournament is held
events.description: Hao Jin stages the inaugural Ruby Phoenix Tournament.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Emperor Halleck IV signs the charter for Fort Korvosa
events.description: Emperor Halleck IV signs the charter establishing the legal framework for Fort Korvosa, an event still commemorated in Korvosa as the Day of Destiny Festival.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Chronicles: Guide to Korvosa

events.name: Cheliax founds Korvosa
events.description: Cheliax establishes Korvosa on its northern Varisian frontier.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Korvosa is founded (Varisia)
Korvosa is founded
events.description: Chelish marines under Field Marshal Jakthion Korvosa establish the settlement that becomes Korvosa. The city commemorates its founding annually on 14 Erastus.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Chronicles: Guide to Korvosa

events.name: Waydon Endrin forms the Sable Company
events.description: Waydon Endrin organizes surviving Chelish marines into the Sable Company, Korvosa's elite military force. The city marks the anniversary each year on 6 Pharast.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Chronicles: Guide to Korvosa

events.name: Everwar ends (Cheliax)
The Everwar ends
events.description: Cheliax abandons its territorial ambitions in Varisia and Belkzen, formally ending the Everwar.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: A coup attempt leads the Decemvirate to adopt masks
events.description: A dispute over foreign influence sparks an attempted coup within the Pathfinder Society, after which the Decemvirate conceals its members' identities behind masks.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide; Pathfinder Society Field Guide

events.name: A secret Decemvirate succeeds the founders
events.description: The sitting Decemvirate retires and appoints successors who wear masks even when meeting one another, making the Society's leadership fully anonymous.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Construction of the Sarini Estate begins near Saringallow
events.description: An invoice preserved in Saringallow's records shows that construction of the main Sarini Estate building began in 4426 AR.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Module: Gallows of Madness

events.name: Woodsedge Lodge is founded
events.description: The Pathfinder Society establishes Woodsedge Lodge in Galt to recover, maintain, and display magical artifacts and historical relics.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Great Fire devastates Korvosa
events.description: A catastrophic fire kills nearly a quarter of Korvosa's population, including former Sable Company commander Waydon Endrin and Captain Keyra Palin.
events.sourceTitle: Guide to Korvosa

events.name: The Great Fire devastates Korvosa
events.description: Shoanti raiders use pitch-covered canoes to ignite Fort Korvosa. The fire destroys the fort and much of the settlement, killing roughly a quarter of its population.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Chronicles: Guide to Korvosa

events.name: Cheliax grants Alika Epakena posthumous citizenship
events.description: Two years after her death fighting Korvosa's Great Fire, the Chelish Empire posthumously recognizes Varisian-born seer Alika Epakena as a Chelish citizen, honoring the martyr later remembered as Saint Alika of Korvosa.
events.sourceTitle: Guide to Korvosa

events.name: Queen Telandia ascends Kyonin's throne
events.description: Telandia Edasseril becomes queen of Kyonin.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Ordrik Talhirk's theocracy collapses
events.description: The Droskarite theocracy ruling the Five Kings Mountains crumbles.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Ordrik’s theocracy crumbles (Five Kings Mountains)
The Seven-Year War begins
events.description: Lung Wa begins the Seven-Year War that ends with its conquest of Tang Mai.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Choral the Conqueror carves Brevoy from the corpses of Rostland and Issia (Brevoy)
Choral the Conqueror founds Brevoy
events.description: Choral the Conqueror unites conquered Rostland and Issia as the nation of Brevoy.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Korvosa forces the Shoanti barbarians to retreat to the Storval Plateau (Varisia)
The Shoanti retreat to the Storval Plateau
events.description: Chelish forces based in Korvosa drive the Shoanti from the lowlands of Varisia.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Forest King Narven dies
events.description: Forest King Narven dies in the Arthfell Forest.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Forest King Narven dies in the Arthfell Forest (Andoran)
Pham Duc Quan becomes emperor of Xa Hoi
events.description: Pham Duc Quan accepts the title of Emperor of Xa Hoi from his predecessor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Explorers discover the Stasis Fields
events.description: Explorers in the Bandu Hills uncover a vast underground prison filled with armored Zenj warriors magically frozen in place.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Castle Everstand is magically erected
events.description: Facing overwhelming orc forces at the Kestrel River, Sergeant Strom Gauntwood draws from a deck of many things and miraculously produces the fortress later named Castle Everstand.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.name: Lastwall's border defenses fail
events.description: Lastwall's defenses suffer a major failure against the hordes of Belkzen.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Lastwall’s border defenses fail against the hordes of Belkzen (Lastwall)
Willowshore and the Tan Sugi monastery are founded
events.description: Sangpotshi master Zhi Hui founds the remote village of Willowshore while establishing the Tan Sugi monastery in the nearby mountain hinterlands.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Stavian I ascends to the Lion Throne of Taldor
events.description: Stavian I succeeds to the Taldan throne, beginning the reign that later includes the Great Purge of Sarenrae's faithful.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Module: Tomb of the Iron Medusa

events.name: Stavian I outlaws Sarenrae's faith in Taldor
events.description: Grand Prince Stavian I outlaws the Cult of the Dawnflower and begins the Great Purge, destroying Sarenite temples and driving or killing the faith's adherents throughout Taldor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Companion: Taldor, Echoes of Glory

events.name: The Pathfinder Society establishes childcare and orphan support
events.description: The Grand Lodge's steward establishes Society-funded childcare near the lodge and creates a fund to support and raise the orphaned children of fallen Pathfinder agents.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Pathfinder Society membership surpasses five thousand
events.description: The Society records more than 5,000 field agents and 112 venture-captains operating from over 30 Inner Sea lodges.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Mengkare begins his experiment on Hermea
events.description: The gold dragon Mengkare begins his grand social experiment on the Isle of Hermea.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The gold dragon Mengkare founds Hermea
Zhi Hui dies in Willowshore
events.description: Willowshore's founder, the Sangpotshi master Zhi Hui, dies of natural causes as the Tan Sugi monastery begins its slow decline.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Willowshore becomes a lumber town
events.description: Shenmen enlists Willowshore in Lung Wa's lumber industry. Local Sangpotshi traditions dwindle, and the remaining monks abandon the Tan Sugi monastery.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: The Night of Broken Blades strikes Willowshore
events.description: An attempt to harvest the sacred sugi grove ends in a mysterious and grisly tragedy remembered as the Night of Broken Blades.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Murder of Lileia Ruel sets Daidian Ruel on the path toward founding the Hellknights
events.description: The public murder of Lileia Ruel becomes the defining personal catalyst for Daidian Ruel's increasingly militant campaign against lawlessness in Cheliax.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Eris Ruel's death drives Daidian Ruel to renounce Aroden
events.description: After Eris Ruel overdoses on pesh at the urging of Path of Grace cultists, his father Daidian publicly renounces Aroden, deepening the personal and ideological crisis that shapes the early Hellknight movement.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: The first Hellknight order, the Order of the Rack, is founded in Westcrown (Cheliax)
The Order of the Rack is founded
events.description: The Order of the Rack, the first Hellknight order, is founded in Westcrown.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Westcrown authorities imprison six of Daidian Ruel's vigilantes
events.description: After Ruel's followers attack members of the Path of Grace, Westcrown authorities arrest and imprison six of his vigilantes as the conflict between sanctioned law and Ruel's movement escalates.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Daidian Ruel is arrested by the Westcrown dottari
events.description: Daidian Ruel is arrested after two Path of Grace cultists are scourged to death, prompting his followers to organize his escape and deepen their break with Westcrown's authorities.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Daidian Ruel's followers destroy the Path of Grace
events.description: By 4577 AR, Ruel's growing militant order has crushed the Path of Grace, one of the criminal cults that helped define the movement's early campaigns.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: King Gaspodar grants Fort Rivad to the Hellknights
events.description: King Gaspodar recognizes the value of Daidian Ruel's militant order and authorizes the restoration of Fort Rivad as a permanent Hellknight stronghold.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Citadel Rivad is completed as the Hellknights' permanent headquarters
events.description: The fortified reconstruction of Fort Rivad is completed, establishing Citadel Rivad as the enduring headquarters of the Hellknight movement.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Chelish explorers from Korvosa settle Magnimar (Varisia)
Chelish settlers establish Magnimar
events.description: Explorers from Korvosa establish the settlement of Magnimar.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Alkenstar discovers Dongun Hold
events.description: Alkenstar enters the Mana Wastes while fleeing persecution from Nex and discovers Dongun Hold.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Alkenstar, fleeing persecution from Nex, discovers Dongun Hold (Mana Wastes).
Yeri and Yuni disappear on the Pilgrim's Path
events.description: The sisters Yeri and Yuni secretly set out for the abandoned Tan Sugi monastery and meet separate, horrific fates along the Pilgrim's Path.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Mount Pho Yim erupts
events.description: Mount Pho Yim violently reawakens in Tang Mai, burning a broad swath of the Sikhyeu Forest.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Citadel Rivad's library burns and Daidian Ruel disappears
events.description: A catastrophic fire destroys Citadel Rivad's library. In the aftermath, Hellknight founder Daidian Ruel vanishes, leaving the order without its original leader.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Lirgen launches a magical starship
events.description: The astrologers of Lirgen send the fully capable magical vessel Lirgen's Glory on its maiden voyage into space.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: The Duchy of Alkenstar is founded
events.description: Alkenstar becomes a duchy and construction begins on the Gunworks.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Duchy of Alkenstar is founded (Mana Wastes)
Heh Shan-Bao becomes governor of Willowshore
events.description: The Lung Wa empire installs Heh Shan-Bao as governor of the remote settlement of Willowshore.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Taldor and Qadira make peace
events.description: Taldor and Qadira reach an uneasy peace after centuries of conflict.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Taldor and Qadira reach an uneasy peace (Taldor/Qadira)
Cheliax prepares for Aroden's return
events.description: King Gaspodar prepares Cheliax for Aroden's prophesied manifestation and the expected Age of Glory.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Fan Hongrui escapes arrest in Willowshore
events.description: Governor Heh attempts to arrest the fugitive singer Fan Hongrui, who uses magic to escape his guards and flees toward the Tan Sugi monastery.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: King Gaspodar of Cheliax prepares for the prophesied manifestation of Aroden (Cheliax)
Aroden dies
Aroden dies and the Age of Lost Omens begins
events.description: Aroden dies; the Eye of Abendego forms, the Worldwound opens, Lirgen and Yamasa drown, and storms wrack the Inner Sea for weeks.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Imperial Lung Wa collapses
events.description: The empire of Lung Wa collapses, leaving its former provinces and neighboring peoples to form new states.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Lung Wa collapses and Willowshore's lumber lords flee
events.description: The collapse of Lung Wa cuts Shenmen's officials off from the empire. Willowshore's lumber lords abandon their estates, while Governor Heh remains to shelter the town from the resulting turmoil.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Pathfinders secure artifacts during Aroden's death
events.description: As Aroden's death throws governments into chaos, Pathfinder agents race to recover and secure important artifacts in the vaults beneath Skyreach.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Feather and Starlight Rebellion liberates Kwanlai
events.description: Kwanlai's clans and allied priests overthrow Lung Wa's imperial officers in coordinated midnight raids as the empire collapses.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Aroden dies and Cheliax begins to fracture
events.description: Aroden's mysterious death ends the Age of Enthronement and throws Cheliax into a succession crisis that develops into civil war.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome; Pathfinder Campaign Setting chronology

events.name: Lang Loi seizes Shenmen
events.description: Shenmen falls under the control of the jorogumo Lang Loi. Chou Mingxia, the elderly ruler of Sze, is slain and returns as a ghost.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: The First Corsair War begins
events.description: Hurricane King Kerdak Bonefist begins preying on Mbe'ke shipping, provoking a dwarven retaliation and the first Corsair War, which lasts through 4611 AR.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: King Gaspodar deploys Hellknights to Molthune and Andoran
events.description: As Cheliax slides toward civil war after Aroden's death, King Gaspodar orders Hellknight forces into Molthune and Andoran to keep order and preserve imperial authority.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Amanandar is founded
events.description: Taldor establishes the overseas colony of Amanandar in Tian Xia.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Thousands abandon Korvosa for Magnimar (Varisia)
Thousands leave Korvosa for Magnimar
events.description: A mass migration carries thousands of people from Korvosa to Magnimar.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Willowshore is trapped between life and death
events.description: Governor Heh's failed ritual kills Willowshore's inhabitants and creates two parallel mindscapes. The townsfolk become trapped in a repeating year while Heh is isolated in a second mindscape.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Season of Ghosts

events.name: Osirians overthrow their Keleshite masters (Osirion)
Osirion overthrows its Keleshite rulers
events.description: Osirians overthrow their Keleshite masters and install Prince Khemet I; Ulizmila also arrives in Darkmoon Vale.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Zo Piaobo is founded
events.description: Pirates establish the floating city of Zo Piaobo.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Ulizmila, reportedly the granddaughter of Baba Yaga, arrives in Darkmoon Vale (Andoran)
Aligois Thels reorganizes the Hellknights into five major orders
events.description: Lictor Aligois Thels formally reorganizes the Hellknights into the Orders of the Chain, Gate, Pyre, Scourge, and Thorn, creating the institutional structure that shapes the organization for centuries.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Hobgoblins seize Kaoling
events.description: Hobgoblin forces capture Kaoling.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Sargava's force incinerated by the child-god Walkena (Mzali)
Walkena destroys Sargava's invading army
events.description: An invading Sargavan force marches on Mzali and is incinerated by the animated remains of the child-god Walkena.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Zhanagorr takes control of Wanshou
events.description: The elder kraken Zhanagorr becomes the patron and ruler of Wanshou.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Zo Piaobo pirates sack Zetang
events.description: Pirates loot Tianjing's capital and destroy sacred treasures, but a sudden storm wrecks their fleet and creates the haunted Graveyard of Kipaku.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Baba Yaga installs her daughter Elvanna as sovereign of Irrisen (Irrisen)
Elvanna becomes queen of Irrisen
events.description: Baba Yaga installs her daughter Elvanna as sovereign of Irrisen.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Oni seize Chu Ye
events.description: Oni forces take control of Chu Ye.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: The astrological philosophers of Lirgen take their own lives (Sodden Lands)
The philosophers of Lirgen take their lives
events.description: After evacuating their people from the Sodden Lands, Lirgen's astrological philosophers die by mass suicide.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Mimsy Galant publishes the first Splatter! folio
events.description: Mimsy Galant publishes the first edition of Splatter!, an annual art folio documenting the constantly changing murals of Brastlewark's Splatter Alley.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Travel Guide

events.name: Firearms reach Tian Xia
events.description: Guns arrive in Tian Xia and are quickly subjected to widespread bans on their use and sale.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Jakalyn assassinates Halamendi Orrus
events.description: Red Mantis assassin Jakalyn kills the first customer of Alkenstar's Gunworks before he can leave the city; the prototype firearm Contessa's Sting disappears.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Legends

events.name: The Gunworks of Alkenstar are completed
events.description: Alkenstar completes the Gunworks, and its first firearms begin reaching wealthy collectors and scholars.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Gunworks of Alkenstar are completed (Mana Wastes)
Absalom besieges the Pathfinder Grand Lodge
events.description: Absalom's leaders launch a twelve-day siege to impose governmental control on the Pathfinder Society, but agents hold the lodge at the cost of hundreds of soldiers' lives.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The faltering Church of Aroden launches the First Mendevian Crusade (Sarkoris)
The First Mendevian Crusade begins
events.description: The declining Church of Aroden launches the First Mendevian Crusade.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Taralu mediators establish neutral ground
events.description: A Taralu delegation led by Anutara Velrits brokers peace between a gnoll band and a conrasu settlement, establishing neutral ground for future meetings.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Modern Bachuan is founded
events.description: The modern nation of Bachuan is established.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Alling Tresorant investigates Crowhollow
events.description: Technic League wizard Alling Tresorant learns of the Crowhollow sinkhole and travels to investigate it, eventually disappearing along with the local Mountain Crow tribe.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Numeria, Land of Fallen Stars

events.name: Citadel Drezen is completed
events.description: Dwarven crusaders complete Citadel Drezen in the Worldwound, creating the fortress that becomes a key stronghold in the final phase of the First Mendevian Crusade.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Sword of Valor

events.name: Lictor Aligois Thels dies
events.description: Aligois Thels, Lictor of the Hellknight Order of the Scourge, dies of natural causes.
events.sourceTitle: Path of the Hellknight, The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: The First Mendevian Crusade ends
events.description: After retaking Mendev and the southern Sarkorian lowlands and reinforcing the region's defenses, the Church of Iomedae formally brings the First Mendevian Crusade to a close.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Player Companion: Demon Hunter's Handbook

events.name: Ilsurian is founded
events.description: Former Knight of Aroden Ilsur leads his followers away from Korvosa and founds the independent settlement of Ilsurian on Lake Syrantula.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Towns of the Inner Sea

events.name: Orynox Marchelin inherits the crown of Kragnaroth
events.description: Fire giant Orynox Marchelin becomes king of Kragnaroth in the Mindspin Mountains following his father's death.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Belkzen, Hold of the Orc Hordes

events.name: The Korvosan royal house is founded
events.description: After years of post-Chelish turmoil, Korvosa establishes a royal house, consolidating the city's new aristocratic order.
events.sourceTitle: Rise of the Runelords Anniversary Edition Player's Guide

events.name: The Misery begins in Falcon's Hollow
events.description: A decade-long period later remembered as the Misery begins as an attic whisperer preys upon the infants and children of Falcon's Hollow's founding families.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King

events.name: Molthune declares independence
events.description: The province of Molthune declares its independence from Cheliax.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The province of Molthune declares its independence from Cheliax (Molthune)
Order of the Thorn captures a House Thrune spy at Citadel Demain
events.description: The Order of the Thorn captures a spy at Citadel Demain, opening negotiations between Lictor DiLavos and House Thrune during the Chelish Civil War.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Order of the Thorn kills two dozen House Thrune supporters
events.description: A disastrous misunderstanding between the Order of the Thorn and House Thrune leaves two dozen Thrune supporters dead and nearly destroys their developing alliance.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Lictor DiLavos meets Agahman of House Thrune in Egorian
events.description: Lictor DiLavos meets Agahman of House Thrune in Egorian, beginning a series of political meetings that draw the Order of the Thorn more deeply into Thrune's rise.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Drezen falls and the Second Mendevian Crusade begins
events.description: Worldwound demons capture Drezen, prompting the beginning of the Second Mendevian Crusade.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Drezen falls to Worldwound demons. The Second Mendevian Crusade begins (Molthune/Sarkoris)
Pathfinder Sheraya Solistar disappears
events.description: The disappearance of Sheraya Solistar of House Asgavan leaves Cheliax without a clear heir and deepens the succession crisis later exploited by House Thrune.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Diabolists of the House of Thrune seize control of Cheliax (Cheliax)
House Thrune seizes Cheliax
events.description: House Thrune ends three decades of civil war and takes control of Cheliax through diabolical power.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Sargava breaks with Thrune-ruled Cheliax
events.description: Sargava rejects the authority of House Thrune after supporting the defeated House Davian during the Chelish Civil War.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Treaty of Egorian establishes the Thrune Ascendancy
events.description: The Treaty of Egorian ends the Chelish Civil War and marks the beginning of House Thrune's rule over Cheliax under Queen Abrogail I.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Cheliax, Empire of Devils

events.name: Sargava becomes independent from Cheliax (Sargava/Cheliax)
Sargava wins independence from Cheliax
events.description: Free Captains hired by Baron Grallus repel the Chelish fleet and secure Sargava's independence.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: Northern Molthune rebels
events.description: The northern half of Molthune rises against the nobles governing from Canorate.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The northern half of Molthune rebels against the avaricious nobles in Canorate (Molthune/Nirmathas)
Oni purge Minkai's royal families
events.description: Oni eliminate Minkai's royal houses, although the Amatatsu family escapes.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Nex demands Nexus House's prison tomes
events.description: Arclord Agrellus Kisk demands that Nexus House surrender texts concerning extraplanar prisons, but Vash-Vatom Torthis refuses and strains relations with Nex's aristocracy.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Nexus House withstands a sixteen-day siege
events.description: After Agrellus Kisk declares Nexus House separate from Nex, Pathfinders defend it from vengeance-seekers and looters until he abruptly reverses the order.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Nirmathas wins independence
events.description: The Molthuni conflict ends with the founding of Nirmathas and the assassination of Irgal Nirmath.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The conflict in Molthune ends with the founding of Nirmathas. Irgal Nirmath is assassinated (Molthune/Nirmathas)
Xoanthurund awakens beneath Galt
events.description: The powerful norgorberite Xoanthurund awakens beneath Galt and begins manipulating the nation's coming revolution.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Hosetter publishes Imperial Betrayal
events.description: The philosopher Hosetter publishes Imperial Betrayal, an influential attack on inherited rule and imperial authority.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Razmiran is established
events.description: Razmir establishes the nation that bears his name.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Razmiran is established (Razmiran)
Razmir destroys Aerduin
events.description: After the Arch-Duchy of Melcat refuses to submit to his rule, Razmir annihilates its capital, Aerduin, killing its inhabitants and leaving behind the haunted ruins later known as Aerduin's Folly.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide; Pathfinder Campaign Setting chronology

events.name: Baron Grallus dies
events.description: Baron Grallus of Sargava dies and Baron Utilinus succeeds him as the colony's ruler.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse

events.name: Darl Jubannich publishes On Government
events.description: Darl Jubannich publishes On Government, providing an intellectual foundation for Galt's revolutionary movement.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The Third Mendevian Crusade begins
events.description: Mendev launches its Third Crusade against the Worldwound.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The third Mendevian Crusade begins (Sarkoris)
The Red Revolution begins
events.description: Revolution erupts in Galt and overturns the old aristocratic order.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The Red Revolution begins (Galt)
Barlin Gablivix massacres the priests of Whiterose Abbey
events.description: Under the influence of the artifact Briar, the exiled priest Barlin Gablivix murders the other priests of Whiterose Abbey. The remote abbey is abandoned, while local accounts incorrectly blame bandits for the massacre.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Kingmaker Adventure Path

events.name: Jakalyn assassinates Irlyna Vosh
events.description: Jakalyn murders the beloved Galtan artist Irlyna Vosh, an assassination later regarded as one of the flash points of the Red Revolution.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Legends

events.name: Galt declares independence
events.description: Hosetter and Darl Jubannich formally declare Galtan independence in the name of the Revolutionary Council, turning widespread unrest into the Red Revolution.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: The People's Revolt transforms Andoran
events.description: Andoran's People's Revolt replaces noble rule with a government founded on popular mandate.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The People’s Revolt transforms Andoran (Andoran)
Andoran declares independence from Cheliax
events.description: The People's Revolt casts off Chelish rule and establishes Common Rule in Andoran. The event is commemorated annually as Liberty Day on 3 Sarenith.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Andoran, Spirit of Liberty; Pathfinder Campaign Setting

events.name: Galt's first Revolutionary Council falls
events.description: Galt's first revolutionary government collapses; Hosetter is executed and Darl Jubannich is driven into exile.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Shining Kingdoms

events.name: Razmir founds Thronestep
events.description: Razmir establishes Thronestep as the capital of Razmiran.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Pya Hundo becomes vash-vatom of Nexus House
events.description: Pya Hundo assumes leadership after his superior is murdered by a summoned genie that steals the magical map Incongruous Domains.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Golden Barb launches from Ostenso
events.description: The ship later known as the Grinning Pixie launches from Ostenso's shipyards.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The Pathfinder Society contracts the Golden Barb
events.description: The Society contracts the Golden Barb during negotiations with Cheliax to reopen Delvehaven.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: The pirates of the Shackles unite
events.description: The pirates of the Shackles organize under one banner to raid northern fleets and merchants.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: The pirates of the Shackles unite (The Shackles)
Foundation of the Palatinates in north-eastern Ustalav (Ustalav)
Akatori founds Shokuro
events.description: The exiled Akatori wanders into northern Lingshen and establishes Shokuro.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Tian Xia World Guide

events.name: Cheliax shutters Delvehaven and cedes the Golden Barb
events.description: After Cheliax closes Delvehaven, the Pathfinder Society claims ownership of the Golden Barb.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.name: Shadow beasts appear in Westcrown
events.description: Mysterious shadow beasts are first recorded in Westcrown.

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Travel Guide

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.description: A powerful earthquake rocks the city of Absalom.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.description: Teenage Prince Carrius II dies in an apparent accident, prompting Eutropia Stavian to break with their father.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Legends

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall

events.description: Over the course of Rova, thirteen enormous eyeless kraken corpses mysteriously wash ashore along the western coast of the Isle of Kortos, an unexplained phenomenon recorded in the early Pathfinder Campaign Setting chronology.

events.name: Catch Me If You Cantrip launches Rabbit in a Hat
events.description: Sarvella publishes Catch Me If You Cantrip, launching the popular Rabbit in a Hat hedge-mystery series featuring mage Tril Spinner and the poppet Bunny.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Travel Guide

events.description: Gnolls surge from White Canyon and attempt to enslave the population of Solku in Katapesh.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Gnolls surge from White Canyon attempting to enslave the population of Solku (Katapesh)
Runelord Karzoug awakens
events.description: Runelord Karzoug awakens in Varisia and begins rebuilding his power.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.description: The runelords begin stirring in Varisia while the Sandpoint murderer Jervis Stoot claims twenty-five victims.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

Birth of Leroy

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.description: The merchant ship Night Terror is found intact off Andoran years after disappearing into the Eye of Abendego, but its entire crew is missing.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: A mob massacres the Pathfinders at Woodsedge Lodge
events.description: Anti-Pathfinder sentiment erupts into an assault that kills the lodge's venture-captain and most Society agents in Galt; a recovery team arrives months later.

events.description: Andoran elects Codwin I as the first Supreme Elect under its republican government.

events.description: The oldest fleshforge in Ecanus abruptly stops working, but the city's leaders respond with complacency.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.description: White Estrid defeats Boiltongue and claims a Linnorm King's crown using strange weapons said to be gifts from earth spirits.

events.name: White Estrid defeats Boiltongue and becomes a Linnorm King (Lands of the Linnorm Kings)
White Estrid raids Nisroch
events.description: White Estrid leads a great raid against Nisroch, breaks through the blockade at the Arch of Aroden, and carries the captured treasure into Absalom's harbor.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Legends

events.name: Jorsal requests a Pathfinder lodge in Nerosyan

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Pathfinder Society Guide

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Baidair Sarini dies after rejection by the Order of the Scourge
events.description: After the Order of the Scourge rejects Baidair Sarini, the Chelish noble attempts to ambush a Hellknight and is killed, adding another violent episode to the order's long political history.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #28: The Infernal Syndrome

events.name: Adventurers reopen Bloodsworn Vale (Varisia)
Bloodsworn Vale reopens

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: The Inner Sea World Guide

events.name: Heroes defeat Runelord Karzoug
events.description: Adventurers defeat Karzoug, and knowledge of Thassilon's surviving mysteries begins spreading across the Inner Sea.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.description: Shahari Orr begins producing monthly shadow-puppet performances that reimagine and extend Olaive Winson's Another Absalom stories.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Travel Guide

events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Impossible Lands

events.description: The Fourth Crusade ends in stalemate after demons retreat and Mendev's exhausted forces can advance no farther.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: World Guide

events.name: The Missing Moment occurs across Golarion
events.description: Aiudara across Golarion flare with brilliant white light. Hundreds of witnesses step through the gates under Osoyo's influence; many never return, while survivors emerge changed and become known as gatewalkers.

events.description: Mago Kai investigates the haunted ruins of Willowshore and begins plans for a new lumber camp, including a mass exorcism whose disruption gives the trapped townsfolk a chance to escape their repeating year.

events.name: Gatewalkers investigation begins in Sevenarches
events.description: Dr. Etward Ritalson escorts his most promising gatewalker agents to the border of Sevenarches for their first formal investigation, beginning the Gatewalkers Adventure Path.

events.name: Hellknights occupy Breachill and begin public executions
events.description: Hellknight forces tighten their control over Breachill, placing the community under occupation and carrying out public executions as resistance grows.

events.name: The Dead Were No Longer Outside
events.description: A death within the refuge destroyed the assumption that remaining underground was still safer than the Gravelands above. The survivors could no longer wait indefinitely beneath Yua's Hope.

The Bloodstone Beneath Corlach
The Corlach Investigation
events.description: Six veteran allies of the Knights of Lastwall were sent into the Gravelands to investigate undead searches around abandoned Ozem positions. Their trail reached Fort Corlach, where surviving defenses, hidden passages, ancient guardians, and the fort's final records led them to one of Arazni's Bloodstones beneath the keep.
events.label: Important/Regional · Investigation / Relic Recovery

events.name: The Search Reached Corlach
The Warden in the Chapel
Twenty Reached Vellumis
Twenty Reached Vellumis
events.description: Twenty survivors reached Vellumis. After defeating Amelia's attempt to seize the Lung Bloodstone, the six leaders delivered the relic safely to Aylunna Varvatos and the refugees were admitted into the city.
events.label: Important/Regional · Arrival / Relic Recovery

events.name: Fort Ozem Fell from Below
Four Bells at Fort Ozem
The Commander Has Fallen
The Fall of Fort Ozem
events.description: Hostile undead forces infiltrated Fort Ozem before the alarm was raised, fought through its defenders, killed the commander, stole the true Chalice, and brought the fortress down from below through its catacombs.
events.label: Important/Regional · Military Attack / Destruction

events.name: Chelish supplies fortify Citadel Altaerein
events.description: Chelish support and supplies reinforce the Hellknight position at Citadel Altaerein as the confrontation around Breachill intensifies.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Hellfire Dispatches

events.name: Hellknights execute Andoren diplomat Reginald Cormoth in Breachill
events.description: A diplomatic mission led by retired Andoren General Reginald Cormoth reaches occupied Breachill to demand an end to Hellknight control. The Hellknights seize Cormoth and publicly execute him, escalating the crisis between Cheliax and Andoran.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #222: Hellbreakers

events.name: Andoran convenes an emergency People's Council over the Breachill crisis
events.description: Public outrage over Reginald Cormoth's execution prompts an emergency People's Council in Almas. After several days of debate, Andoran authorizes Steel Falcons to travel to Isger and intervene against the Hellknight occupation.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #222: Hellbreakers

events.name: Andoran's People's Council condemns the execution of Reginald Cormoth
events.description: Following an emergency People’s Council in Almas, Supreme Elect Andira Marusek publicly condemns the Order of the Rack's execution of retired General Reginald Cormoth and declares that any members involved who enter Andoran will be arrested and tried.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Hellfire Dispatches

events.name: Battle of Hellknight Hill returns Breachill to Andoran
events.description: Andoren forces and their allies defeat the Hellknight occupation at Citadel Altaerein and retake Breachill during the opening phase of the Hellfire Crisis.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #222: Hellbreakers

events.name: Sword of Mortality Karsakim issues claim on Khari
events.description: Karsakim, Sword of Mortality and leader of Rahadoum's Pure Legion, publicly declares that Khari and its surrounding territories should be freed from Chelaxian and Asmodean rule and returned to the Laws of Mortality.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Hellfire Dispatches

events.name: Andoran clashes with Brastlewark at the Aspodean Wall
events.description: Fighting at the newly completed Aspodean Wall pits Andoren forces and Golden Legionnaires against Chelaxian troops, infernal creatures, and Brastlewark gnomes, while signs of dissent emerge within Brastlewark itself.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Hellfire Dispatches

events.name: Hellbreakers celebrate before the next phase of the war
events.description: The Hellbreakers gather for a celebration dinner as the campaign transitions into the next phase of the Hellfire Crisis.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #222: Hellbreakers

events.name: Chitterwood Offensive retakes Logas
events.description: Andoren forces launch the Chitterwood Offensive and retake Logas as the Hellfire Crisis expands across Isger.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #222: Hellbreakers

events.name: Caeto strikes Saringallow on the Day of Bones
events.description: Caeto launches a major strike against Saringallow during the Day of Bones, escalating the fighting around the city.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #222: Hellbreakers

events.name: Battle of Saringallow begins
events.description: The Battle of Saringallow begins as the Hellfire Crisis enters a major new phase of open warfare in Isger.
events.sourceTitle: Pathfinder Adventure Path #222: Hellbreakers
